note: B3 TRIAL 2 (plans/BATTERY-GAUGE-REFINE-PLAN.md, B3; trial 1 and its lessons in ../battery-2026-10-07-partial-charge/). The board ran flat at 07:56:00-07:56:08 10-08 (trial 1's video).
